title: Close ordinary BIT interchange under heterogeneous recursive cycles
body:
This construction lets one fixed ordinary BIT program serve both the public entry and all smaller ordinary calls of a funded word through a **cover-free block splitter**. The splitter can earn zero coarse saving. Inserting a bounded chain of such entries preserves the funded characteristic up to a fixed logarithmic power, and preserves every strictly funded pure exponent. One program and one cutoff serve those prices for a fixed compiled word. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/PROOF.md) · [Complete caller and costs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/APPLICATION.md) · [Implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/interchange.py) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/RESULT.json)

**Actual producer and consumer.** Split each of two address fields into halves. Send both corresponding block swaps to the pending four-return word and route every smaller ordinary call from that word back through the splitter. Every request carries the full arbitrary payload, including the odd last block. The splitter borrows no cover row. Its companion pays for the native cover, both reversed bodies, weighted leaves, bad classes and restoration. The elementary digit base supplies all terminal moves.

| Public BIT service | Funded ordinary saving | What it supplies |
|---|---:|---|
| Two-block entry with the pending primary compiler | 0.003879927836154 | The pending multiplier's full original ordinary price of 0.003879927836145 |
| Two-block entry with the independent lower certificate | 0.003879907846154 | Its full independently certified covered price |
| Selected paired word as entry to the asymmetric cycle | ≥ 0.003879632977211447 | The stronger pending multiplier's tested price of 0.00387944011075 |

The original selected word on its own fails that stronger test under its signed tariff. All three public entries have a complete consumer. The pending rational proposal still gives **κ = 0.00387944011068** under the five source assumptions. The rational invoice still fails its higher enrolled target. [Selected review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr7000-application/PROOF-REVIEW.md) · [Pending rational application](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/application.json) · [Pending primary finite certificate](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/binary/FINITE.json)

**Why the recursion closes.** A smaller field can still carry the entire input. Splitting a genuine spectator gives each live child at most half the parent's volume. The ordered returns preserve every bit and independent productive output. A block splitter can use widths proportional to its input. Only the funded part has to contract the logarithm of the width. Charging the splitters before solving the recurrence preserves the exponent and linear visited backing. The asymmetric variant also requires revised global stock and outer movement bounds.

**Comparison and limits.** A repriced finite stack of four stages already reaches the primary numerical price. The new capability is arbitrary-width, mutually callable block entries that preserve the complete funded service, including each strict price of a fixed companion. Ordinary prices here are asymptotic. The asymmetric selected entry needs log₂(e) > 59,326,000,000,000,000 when its cover is active. The two-block example keeps the pending stock exponent of 1/250. The source assumptions remain `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery`. Independent scientific acceptance remains open.

**Sources and credit.** @CubeJerry supplied the selected words. @Clear1nsight supplied the four-return successor, both binary receipts and the original complete consumer. The application retains the earlier dual-supplier gate. @rohanarun supplied the finite bootstrap, @jmbarrancoml the physical ordinary sites, and @mason-hale the segment allocation. Ali Romman (@aliromman) prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. **Verification.** From the repository root, use CPython 3.12 and its standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange
```

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange outcome=completed
```

All seven registered commands passed on the submitted commit and in a read-only Git-free export. Six distinct service prices passed both complete application gates, with 54 strict and four functional inequalities per substitution. The fixed-count tests compared 403,530 labelled positions and checked 1,536 request configurations. Separate adversarial workers challenged timing, space and the two consumers. The pending primary and independent finite binary verifiers reproduced their archived JSON byte-for-byte. Full native templates and the numerical multiplier were not executed. [Verification and objections](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/VALIDATION.md) · [Application checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/check_application.py) · [Commands](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f927ed7ffbb2b8870f109d59ddd94e1f87becb13/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/VERIFY.json)

**Hosted status.** GitHub stopped in the shared onboarding test before selecting research packages. The canonical CI guide specifies `make frontier6030-verify`. The selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. I reproduced this failure on the unmodified base. GitHub skipped hosted package replay.
